speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a surprising concern from your previous doctor, as ocular TB typically presents with granulomatous inflammation and pain rather than painless, progressive vision loss with "black spots," which is the hallmark of necrotizing retinitis. Given your low CD4 count history and these specific symptoms, I must rule out CMV retinitis immediately.
